modelingNotes: The exact manufacturer catalogue row at physical p.73 / printed B.23 maps order 1665230000 to HDC 10B DODQ 4BO under Cover / For bases in the RockStar IP65 Size 4 housing selection. The adjacent photograph and drawing are this base cover; identity and mechanical function do not rely on a size-6 sibling.
The upper Cover / For hoods row on the same page is a different product, 1665240000 / HDC 10B DMDQ 2QB. It is not substituted for this base cover.

This cover is a mechanical closure for compatible size 4 bases. The exact row/drawing shows no electrical terminals, numbered contacts or dedicated PE/bond terminal. There are zero circuit functions and no fixed electrical links. Mechanical connector metadata describes attachment only, with no electrical pins.

The page places this cover within the RockStar IP65 housing selection. IP65 is conditional on the correctly closed compatible base/cover assembly and its sealing; it is not asserted for a loose cover or an open assembly. The exact installed pairing and assembly condition are outside this model.

No earth continuity is inferred through cover metalwork, closure hardware or the illustrated retaining tether. Any enclosure protective-bonding path must be established separately for the actual assembly; the cover model does not provide that path.

Material/alloy, coating, hinge construction, net weight, service-temperature limits and generic family NEMA claims are not established by the exact row used here and are omitted. No dimensions or ratings are transferred from a sibling. Installed hardware revision remains unverified.
